canonical_project: Pelagos Data Centres Gibraltar (near Port of Gibraltar)
notes: 250 MW total is announced/planned capacity across five phases (up to 250 MW by 2033, potential beyond 1 GW per LinkedIn coverage); ~GBP1.8bn project on ~20,000 sq m site near Port of Gibraltar (Neil Pinero Rd per Data Center Map). Ground-breaking reported Sep 2025 (World Construction Network) - status now construction; first phase targeted operational late 2027, later phases every 18 months. Tier III design, carrier-neutral, PUE <=1.2, renewable + LNG, independent of existing grid. Existence/plan = A (HMGoG announcement); construction-start claim = B (trade press).
